desc: 墨黑面板配暖橡木纹与大理石白，空界面空分栏承载家庭娱乐叙事
leaf: 十寸家用娱乐平板电脑
name: 十寸暖家娱乐平板款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代大屏比例与哑光背壳。
用早餐桌俯拍的空白应用格界面，把娱乐入口排成可替换的干净版式。
用三台由小到大的素黑机身与空白对角量线，让买家按屏幕档位挑款。
用沙发上手持平分双栏的观看瞬间，演示边看边玩的并行娱乐。
用双手捧机膝上观影的近景，让大屏占比与窄边框自己说话。
把配保护壳的阅读时刻放上户外咖啡桌，用一杯茶的时间讲长续航陪伴。
收口促单，用厨房中岛上立起支架的视频通话画面，把平板写成家的连线中心。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless soft white #FBFAF8 sweep for the opening packshot, warm oak slat table and marble countertop as the recurring home stages, cream sofa knit bokeh inside the two seated frames, sunlit kitchen window greenery bokeh in the closing frame, no dark tech stages
style.direction: warm domestic entertainment tablet commerce, oak tables and marble light
style.iconSystem: blank rounded app tiles in a quiet grid with no glyphs, empty diagonal measure lines across dark screens, one blank lower caption slab per lifestyle frame, no store brands, no platform marks
style.lightingSystem: soft warm household daylight near 5200K, open window fill with gentle direction, easy shadows on wood, one faint screen glow on knuckles in seated frames, never cold studio blue
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm domestic entertainment tablet ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte black panel #232527, warm oak #C89B66, marble white #F2F0ED and soft terracotta accent #D98E5F; soft warm household daylight near 5200K with open window fill, easy shadows on wood and one faint screen glow on knuckles; oak slats, marble veins, cream knit throws, white ceramic and plain linen only, no chrome, no glass desks, no dark tech stages; one friendly geometric sans kept as empty placeholder tiles, labels and slabs; blank app tiles without glyphs and empty diagonal measure lines; blank dark glass screens and unmarked bezels; no color palette changes, no readable interface, no brand wordmarks, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable interface or app icons
style.presentationRules: screens are always blank dark glass or a plain untitled wash with no interface text, the tablet shows only its own unmarked bezel and rear camera, hands are generic adults of any age cropped from the chin down, accessories stay wordmark-free
style.surfaceSystem: matte black tablet shell with satin bezel, oak slats and marble veins, cream knit throws, white ceramic cup and saucer, plain linen napkin, no chrome, no glass desks
style.typography: one friendly geometric sans in ink #232527, every headline, app tile, caption and size label kept as an empty placeholder
